Pin ~253 m (wrong side of creek; elevation 753 -> ~649). Phone '' -> 423-735-1500.
flags: WATERFRONT --AWH creekside (unchanged) AGREES: rec.gov 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront' on sites 03-10 (8 of 10 nightly sites, all reservable); Beaverdam Creek is a mountain stream well under 30 m wide in the gorge, so creekside not riverfront. Canopy hides the pads.

PIN MOVE ~253 m: stored 36.5968,-81.8215 is on the forested slope west of Beaverdam Creek (3DEP 720 m). OSM's campground node 36.59604,-81.81883 sits on the TN 133 side between road and creek (3DEP 648.7 m; rec.gov 'elevation of 2,100 feet' = 640 m). Stored elevation 753 -> ~649.
Rig length: only four sites post one (50, 90, 84, 60 ft), and 'All equipment must fit on the site pad'. max_rig_ft not written.
Status: closed for the season now (normal; season 4/27-10/13). No status written.
